clue.text: Hostile European male in charge of a learner

parts.note: a Pole is a native of Poland
L is the learner sign on a British L-plate

explanation.surface: A man from Europe, put in charge of a learner, behaves aggressively towards the pupil.
explanation.definitionFit: Polemical writing or speech attacks opinions forcefully, so it is combative and antagonistic.

clue.text: Tree that ascends to the heavens

definitions.meaning: the London ... is a common broad-leaved tree
an aeroplane climbs up into the sky

explanation.surface: A tree so tall it seems to reach up into the sky.
explanation.definitionFit: One word names both the tree and the aircraft, short for aeroplane.

clue.text: Put into a group and given guidance about fever

indicators.note: about means the word for given guidance goes around the word for fever

parts.note: led means guided or directed
ague is a fever with shivering, as in malaria

explanation.surface: A feverish patient is placed in a ward and given instructions.
explanation.definitionFit: Leagued means allied or joined together in a league, an association of parties.

clue.text: Trader terribly small-minded when losing pounds and shillings

indicators.note: terribly signals the letters of small-minded must be badly jumbled
when losing means some letters are dropped from the fodder before rearranging

parts.note: L, from Latin libra, is the symbol for pounds sterling
S is the old abbreviation for shillings in pre-decimal British money

explanation.surface: A dreadfully petty merchant cuts out the pounds and shillings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when losing' drops L and S from SMALLMINDED, and 'terribly' rearranges the remaining nine letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A middleman is an intermediary dealer who buys from producers and sells on to retailers or consumers.

clue.text: Get fired up with study, then flop with speed

parts.note: to con is an old word for to study or learn
to flag or flop is to droop wearily
rate means pace or speed

explanation.surface: Someone becomes enthusiastic about studying, then quickly collapses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Get fired up' sounds like enthusiasm, but it is literal: to conflagrate is to catch fire.
explanation.definitionFit: A conflagration is a great blaze, so the verb means to burst into flames.

clue.text: Drink making chum upset

indicators.note: upset in a down clue means turned upside down, so the word for chum reads from bottom to top

parts.note: a pal is a friend or chum

explanation.surface: A beverage that leaves a friend unwell.
explanation.definitionFit: To lap is to drink by scooping liquid with the tongue, as a cat does.

clue.text: Opposing editor, I start to criticise old-style language

parts.note: V stands for versus, meaning against or opposing

indicators.note: the start of the word criticise supplies its opening letter only

explanation.surface: A contrary editor plans to attack some archaic tongue.
explanation.definitionFit: Vedic is the ancient form of Sanskrit in which the Vedas, the oldest Hindu scriptures, were composed.

clue.text: Dishonourable archdeacon, liar regularly shown up

parts.note: an archdeacon is addressed as the Venerable, abbreviated Ven

indicators.note: shown up in a down clue means the chosen letters run upwards, reversed
regularly takes every other letter of liar, beginning with the first

explanation.surface: A disreputable churchman's lies are routinely exposed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes L and A from liar, and 'shown up' turns them to AL beneath VEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Venal describes someone open to bribery and corruption, hence lacking honour.

clue.text: Shortage that could help make ground rough then?

indicators.note: could help make says the words ground rough then each contribute some of their letters to the result

explanation.surface: A water shortage that might leave the earth rough, then.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads as a whole-clue description of dry weather, but the letters run across 'ground rough then'.
explanation.definitionFit: A drought is a long spell without rain, a shortage of water; the term also covers any prolonged scarcity.

clue.text: Stock market operators seen as folk demanding reform

definitions.meaning: technical analysts who predict share prices from graphs of past movements
members of the 1830s and 1840s British movement campaigning for universal male suffrage

explanation.surface: City traders are seen as radicals pressing for change.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses come from a chart: price graphs for traders, the People's Charter for the reformers.

clue.text: Lack of inhibition of a music group performing

parts.note: a band is a group of musicians
a performer who is on is currently on stage

explanation.surface: A band playing live may well throw off its inhibitions.
explanation.definitionFit: To act with abandon is to behave freely, without restraint or self-consciousness.

clue.text: The first woman to criticise another

parts.note: to pan a play or film is to review it harshly
another woman, here the name Dora

explanation.surface: Eve, the first woman, is apparently out to find fault with someone else.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The first woman' suggests Eve, but in Greek myth the first mortal woman was Pandora; 'another' carries 'woman' over, so it means another woman's name.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek mythology Zeus had Pandora made as the first human female, later famous for opening the jar of evils.

clue.text: Match of supreme quality

indicators.note: the letters are taken from inside the words supreme quality, spanning the join between them

explanation.surface: A sporting contest of the very highest standard.
explanation.definitionFit: To match something is to be its peer, the same in size, value or standard.

clue.text: Illumination feeble, inadequate — tricky situation

indicators.note: inadequate means falling short, so the word for feeble is cut short by its final letter

parts.note: a lame excuse is a feeble one
a plight is a difficult or dangerous predicament

explanation.surface: A weak, insufficient light leaves someone in a bit of a fix.
explanation.definitionFit: Lamplight is the glow cast by a lamp, a form of artificial lighting.

clue.text: Maiden is dreadful, having performed topless — given wrong advice?

parts.note: M is the cricket abbreviation for maiden, an over with no runs scored
dire means dreadful or terrible

indicators.note: topless means the word for performed loses its first letter

parts.note: acted means performed on stage

explanation.surface: A young woman's awful show, staged without a top, was ill-advised.
explanation.walkthrough: 'topless' suggests nudity; it removes the A from ACTED.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone misdirected has been pointed the wrong way, as by bad instructions or advice.

clue.text: Youngster for whom older woman lacks yen

indicators.note: lacks means the word for older woman is without the letter for yen

parts.note: a lady is a polite word for a mature woman
Y is the abbreviation for the Japanese yen

explanation.surface: A boy toy for a mature woman who has lost her longing for him.
explanation.walkthrough: 'yen' looks like a longing, which suits the romantic surface, but it is the Japanese currency, Y.
explanation.definitionFit: A lad is a boy or young man.

clue.text: Scout sale turning out to be unsuccessful enterprise

indicators.note: turning out signals the letters of Scout sale are turned into a fresh order

explanation.surface: A Scout jumble sale proves a flop.
explanation.definitionFit: A lost cause is a venture or aim certain to fail, beyond hope of success.

clue.text: More than one wise man on street thinks highly of judges

parts.note: the Magi were the wise men who visited the infant Jesus; magi is the plural of magus
to rate someone is to value them highly

explanation.surface: Several sages out on the street admire members of the bench.
explanation.definitionFit: Magistrates are lay or professional justices who try minor cases in British courts.

clue.text: One right to be taking break outside, being able to get back to normal

definitions.text: being able to get back to normal

indicators.note: taking means the word for break holds the other pieces
outside means the word for break sits around the others

parts.note: a rest is a break or pause
I is the Roman numeral for one
a lien is a legal right to keep another's property until a debt is paid

explanation.surface: Someone entitled to a break outdoors recovers well.
explanation.walkthrough: 'right' is the legal sense: LIEN, a claim on property.
explanation.definitionFit: Resilient people or materials recover quickly, springing back to their former state.

clue.text: Subordinate types support stars

parts.note: to second a motion is to back it
Aries is a constellation, a group of stars

explanation.surface: Junior staff are there to back the celebrities.
explanation.definitionFit: Secondaries are things or people of lesser rank, coming after the primary ones.

clue.text: Quality of safe-keeping probed by old-style politician

indicators.note: probed by means the word for safe-keeping is pierced by the politician

parts.note: something in your care is in your safe-keeping
Lib is short for a Liberal, from the party merged into the Liberal Democrats in 1988

explanation.surface: An old-fashioned MP investigates the standard of custody.
explanation.definitionFit: Calibre means the degree of merit or excellence, as in a person of high calibre.

clue.text: Island producing salad component

definitions.meaning: ..., or Kos, is a Greek island in the Dodecanese
a crisp long-leaved lettuce, called romaine in America

explanation.surface: An island that grows something for the salad bowl.
explanation.definitionFit: The lettuce takes its name from the Greek island, so both senses share one word.

clue.text: Tea party going wild on account of "low swinger"?

parts.note: cha, or char, is an informal word for tea
a riot is a wild, uproarious party

explanation.surface: A tea party gets out of hand because of some dubious swinger.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition alludes to the spiritual 'Swing Low, Sweet Chariot', also sung by English rugby crowds.
explanation.definitionFit: The song asks the vehicle to swing low and carry the singer home.

clue.text: Vegetable from experimental station about to be put in box

indicators.note: to be put in means the two pieces go inside the word for box

parts.note: a case is a box or container
a lab, short for laboratory, is where experiments are carried out
RE is Latin for concerning, about

explanation.surface: Produce from a research station is about to be packed in a crate.
explanation.definitionFit: Calabrese is a type of green sprouting broccoli, named after Calabria in Italy.

clue.text: Copper's round of duty, nabbing second nasty person

indicators.note: nabbing means the word for the round grabs and holds the letter

parts.note: a police officer's beat is the area patrolled

explanation.surface: A policeman on patrol arrests a thug in moments.
explanation.definitionFit: A beast is a cruel or brutish person.

clue.text: Forbidden city, alas, terribly hard to enter

indicators.note: to enter means the letter for hard goes inside the rearranged letters
terribly suggests the word alas is badly mangled into a new order

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

explanation.surface: A city off limits, and sadly very difficult to get into.
explanation.walkthrough: 'terribly' turns ALAS into LASA, and 'to enter' puts H after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Lhasa, capital of Tibet, was long closed to foreigners and so nicknamed the Forbidden City.

clue.text: For Scot it's no good being stuck in Australia

indicators.note: being stuck in means the letters for no good are lodged inside the abbreviation for the country

explanation.surface: A Scot finds it useless being stranded Down Under.
explanation.definitionFit: Angus is a Scottish man's first name, so stands for a Scotsman.

clue.text: Annoyance of university doctor followed by fury

indicators.note: followed by places the word for fury after the first pieces

parts.note: MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a medical degree, so stands for a doctor
rage is violent anger

explanation.surface: A medic from the university loses their temper, much to everyone's irritation.
explanation.definitionFit: To take umbrage is to take offence, so it means resentment or irritation.

clue.text: Your setter is upset, getting lost in wood

indicators.note: in places the letter for lost inside the reversed pronoun
upset in a down clue means the word for your setter is turned upwards

parts.note: the setter refers to himself as me
L is the abbreviation for lost, as in sports results tables

explanation.surface: The setter is distressed at going astray in a forest.
explanation.definitionFit: Elm is a hardwood timber from the elm tree.

clue.text: Operatic work presented by the fellow in Herts town

indicators.note: in places the word for the fellow inside the town's name

parts.note: Tring is a market town in Hertfordshire, an English county north of London
he refers to the fellow, a man

explanation.surface: A man stages an opera in a small town north of London.
explanation.walkthrough: TRING is a small market town in Hertfordshire (Herts), an English county north of London.
explanation.definitionFit: Wagner's four-opera cycle Der Ring des Nibelungen is commonly called simply by this short name.

clue.text: Leave river by rear half of boat

parts.note: the Exe is a river in Devon, south-west England

indicators.note: rear half of means only the back two letters of the word boat

explanation.surface: Abandon the river from the back of the vessel.
explanation.walkthrough: An exeat is formal permission for a pupil to be absent from a British boarding school.
explanation.definitionFit: An exeat is a permitted absence, a kind of leave granted to a student.

clue.text: Thinks that could be estimated

indicators.note: that could be says the letters of estimated could be rearranged into something else

explanation.surface: Someone muses on what might be a rough guess.
explanation.definitionFit: To meditate is to reflect deeply or contemplate.
